text: Official SDKs let developers create and manage assistants programmatically
quote: const assistant = await vapi.assistant

text: Official CLI lets you manage assistants, phone numbers, and calls from the terminal, auto-detecting your stack
quote: Manage assistants, phone numbers, and calls from your terminal

text: CLI can forward webhook events to a local server for debugging
quote: vapi listen --forward-to localhost:3000/webhook

text: CLI supports switching between organizations and environments
quote: Switch between organizations and environments seamlessly

text: Official MCP server exposes Vapi APIs so any MCP-compatible AI assistant or agent framework can manage assistants, numbers, and calls
quote: so you can manage assistants, phone numbers, and calls from any MCP-compatible AI assistant (like Claude Desktop) or agent framework

text: Assistants can call external functions/custom tools mid-conversation via webhooks (OpenAI-style function calling)
quote: Vapi supports OpenAI-style tool/function calling. Assistants can ping your server to perform actions.

text: Voice Library in the dashboard lets you browse and preview every available voice and copy its ID for use
quote: The Voice Library in the Vapi Dashboard lists every voice available to your organization. Browse and preview voices there

text: You can supply your own custom voice with any supported TTS provider via the assistant's voice property
quote: You can use your own custom voice with any supported provider by setting the `voice` property in your assistant configuration

text: HIPAA compliance can be enabled directly from the Dashboard
quote: HIPAA compliance can be ensured by turning on HIPAA compliance in the Dashboard.

text: Single Sign-On (Okta, Azure AD, SAML, OIDC) and role-based access control are supported
quote:
Single Sign On (SSO) supported for Okta, Azure AD, SAML, and OIDC
* Role Based Access Control (RBAC)

text: Voice Test Suites let you test AI voice agents through simulated phone conversations, with an AI tester following a script
quote: Voice Test Suites enable you to test your AI voice agents through simulated phone conversations.

text: Evals framework lets you systematically test assistants and squads with mock conversations and automated validation
quote: Evals is Vapi's AI agent testing framework that enables you to systematically test assistants and squads using mock conversations with automated validation.

text: You can dial into your assistant using any SIP softphone via a SIP URI
quote: Use any SIP softphone (e.g., Zoiper, Linphone) to dial your SIP URI

text: Assistants can be tuned between an Ultra Fast (low-latency) mode and a High Intelligence (higher-capability) mode
quote: Ultra Fast uses speed-optimized models for lower latency. High Intelligence accepts higher latency for greater capability.

text: Dashboard offers a pre-built Customer Support assistant template to start from
quote: Select the down arrow next to Create Assistant, then choose Customer Support.

text: You can create a voice assistant, connect a phone number, and make your first calls, typically within minutes
quote: Create a voice assistant, connect it to a phone number, and make your first calls.

text: Existing Make scenarios and GoHighLevel workflows can be imported directly into Vapi
quote: Import existing Make scenarios and GHL workflows directly into Vapi

text: You can test an assistant live via a web call in the Dashboard using your microphone
quote: Select Talk to start a web call. When prompted, allow the Dashboard to use your microphone.

text: CLI/dev tooling lets you build, test, and deploy voice AI apps without leaving your development environment
quote: Build, test, and deploy voice AI applications without leaving your development environment.

text: IDE AI assistants (Cursor, Windsurf, VSCode) can be given complete, accurate knowledge of Vapi's APIs via agent-oriented docs
quote: Your IDE's AI assistant (Cursor, Windsurf, VSCode) gains complete, accurate knowledge of Vapi's APIs and best practices. No more hallucinated code or outdated examples.
